lines: I speak the rite that steadies doubting minds.
proof, not promise, is its door.
Picture ember-triangle enthroned on the left palm,
letter-fed, wind-waked, white-hot.
sanskrit_cite: trikoṇe vahnisadane vahnivarṇojjvale@bhitaḥ | vāyavyapuranirdhūte kare savye sujājvale

lines: Take one small seed; burn it inward, burn it outward,
held in muttering thought till the true one sees it char.
sanskrit_cite: bījaṃ kiṃcidgṛhītvaitattathaiva hṛdayāntare | kare ca dahyamānaṃ saccintayettajjapaikayuk

lines: Phaṭ on phaṭ, the fire unbroken — the grain gives up
its future; sterility, demonstrated.
Charred grain never greens. So too the soul-stains,
when spell and sitting and rite conspire to burn.
sanskrit_cite: taptaṃ naitatprarohāya tenaiva pratyayena tu | malamāyākhyakarmāṇi mantradhyānakriyābalāt

lines: Ash, and no sequel. This the gracious Master showed me —
Śambhunātha's proof, handed down.
sanskrit_cite: dagdhāni na svakāryāya nirbījapratyayaṃ tvimam | sa śrīmānsuprasanno me śaṃbhunātho nyarūpayat

lines: Yet gather even the ash: grace rebinds the grain on high,
for bright initiation frees the rooted stone.
sanskrit_cite: bījasyāpyatra kāryā ca yojanā kṛpayā guroḥ | yato dīkṣā sudīptatvātsthāvarāṇyapi mocayet

lines: Spell, fire, worship, sitting — master all within,
and every rite you touch turns evident.
sanskrit_cite: yo gururjapahomārcādhyānasiddhatvamātmani | jñātvā dīkṣāṃ carettasya dīkṣā sapratyayā smṛtā

lines: The cast-off, the rule-free, the knower — not for them;
the bound keep rites, and rites keep proof for them.
sanskrit_cite: avadhūte nirācāre tattvajñe natvayaṃ vidhiḥ | sācāraiḥ kriyate dīkṣā yā dṛṣṭapratyayānvitā

lines: Who needs no rule needs no proof shown;
knowing knows itself, and asks no second prize.
sanskrit_cite: nirācāreṇa dīkṣāyāṃ pratyayastu na gadyate | jñānaṃ svapratyayaṃ yasmānna phalāntaramarhati

lines: Let fruit ripen the sitting, the old book says —
or weigh the man, and let the balance say.
sanskrit_cite: dhyānādi tu phalātsādhyamiti siddhāmatoditam | tulāśuddhiparīkṣāṃ vā kuryātpratyayayoginīm

lines: One Tantra speaks it, one Tantra hints;
both mouth the Lord, both bind the doubt.
sanskrit_cite: yathā śrītantrasadbhāve kathitā parameśinā | śrīpūrvaśāstre@pyeṣā ca sūcitā parameśinā

lines: Joy, lift, tremor, sleep, and swirl — five rungs
by which the Power is known in men.
sanskrit_cite: ānanda udbhavaḥ kampo nidrā ghūrṇiśca pañcamī | ityevaṃvadatā śaktitāratamyābhidhāyinā

lines: Lightness lifts when flesh-forgetfulness falls —
earth was chief till soaring called.
sanskrit_cite: udbhavo laghubhāvena dehagrahatirohiteḥ | deho hi pārthivo mukhyastadā mukhyatvamujjhati

lines: Chant the soon-light spell, see him adrift aloft,
then finish every rite as told before.
sanskrit_cite: bhāvilāghavamantreṇa śiṣyaṃ dhyātvā samutplutam | karmāṇi tatrāśeṣāṇi pūrvoktānyācaredguruḥ

lines: So the weighing-rite stands told —
the rite whose gift is proof.
